sources_note: Official names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on every entry). Each guide below is written in the entrant's own words for this entry and cites the guide or list it draws on; no guide text is copied from any source.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task: follow the roadmap (story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands), keep cheats off, and it unlocks automatically. Expect roughly 200 hours in total.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI PSN trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Story missions unlock in order, so just play through the opening; it pops when the mission ends. Nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI PSN trophy list

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. The trophy pops a little late, once you clear the first mission or two of Chapter 2. While you are in Chapter 1, do the optional morning meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing that can pass you by.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI PSN trophy list

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies it can pop a mission or two into the next chapter. By now both characters can roam together, which opens the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI PSN trophy list

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Several side strands open in this chapter (Andy's, Randy's, Tyrone's), and the Snap Gun from a Chapter 3 main mission is what Sneakthief needs later, so keep playing the story and pick up strands as they call.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI PSN trophy list

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter — take it when it appears, because the vault robberies feed Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI PSN trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. After the credits, free roam continues and the 100% checklist opens (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), so nothing is locked away by finishing the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI PSN trophy list

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — it opens after the story; progress made during the story already counts). The checklist is lenient, closer to 60% of true completion: 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts, any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals; robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything, and 15 of 18 card sets. Most of it comes from doing the other trophies. This is the hardest trophy and the bulk of the ~200 hours.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts of any kind: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 in the world. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy — a stunt is any jump, bridge flight or base jump the game registers, and the counter is visible in your stats.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You only need one of each — the cheapest way is one fishing trip, one hunt, one round of golf, one range visit, one pool game, one basketball game, one arcade game, one race and one stunt jump.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges are one of the 9 activity types, and the 100% checklist needs every range too, so this is not extra work — practice each challenge until the gold threshold shows, and use the range's own weapon so the scoring matches.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race; winning once per location is enough, and the 100% checklist needs every drone race too. Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win — a clean line beats raw speed on the tight ones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, and each race only counts once, so work through the race list rather than repeating one you like. Races also feed the 100% checklist, and a faster car or bike makes the later ones much easier.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in Chapter 1 and he texts you a fishing spot afterwards — go to it and take the challenge. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this pulls double duty.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any one in-game video game through to the end. Three run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines around Leonida — pick the shortest one and finish it. It also counts as the video-game activity for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. It starts with a phone call in Chapter 3 and only Lucia can do it, so switch to her when the call comes. Play the strand's missions through to the last one; side strands stay available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand: 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so do not worry if he disappears — he comes back and the strand stays open after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2 — head to the mud club when the strand appears and play its missions through to the last one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some side questlines count, and which ones is still being confirmed — the safe play is to finish every stranger strand you find (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest). You can do them all after the story, and this is not part of the 100% checklist, so it is the natural last step before the platinum.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand: a wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3. Find the cars on the list and deliver them as asked; a car you already own can count, so check your garages before hunting for a new one.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down the labs in Vice City. Only Jason can do it, and it opens from Chapter 3 — switch to Jason, follow the strand's missions, and shut each lab down as directed.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida (the 100% checklist needs 15 of 18). THE ONLY TROPHY THAT MAY BE MISSABLE: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony — follow her and accept the optional quest. She shows you how it works, and that meditation is gone after Chapter 1. It is not marked as a meditation spot like the other 18, and it is unclear whether the trophy needs it, but it takes a minute and removes the risk — do it when it comes up. For the other spots, work through the 18 marked locations; the checklist counts 15 of 18 for 100%, but this trophy needs every spot.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Only Jason can do it, from Chapter 2. Which animal triggers it is not yet confirmed by the guide writers — the safe route is to clear all 15 of Bret's target decks, which the 100% checklist needs anyway, and the hunt should complete along the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick the three easiest sets and finish them; you do not need all 18 for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs 15 of 18, so keep collecting after it pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count — open the app whenever you pass something notable and scan it. It pairs naturally with exploring the map for The Goodtime State and with scanning new vehicles for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. Challenges cover almost everything you do — driving, shooting, exploring, robbing — so play normally and check the challenge list in the menu to see which ones are close. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this comes on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner along and escape. It is possible once both characters can roam together, from Chapter 2. The easy way: bank jobs give 4 stars anyway, so do one with your partner and then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing the wanted level. Pick three shops close together, hit them in quick succession, and keep moving — the trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third shop. Do not stop to fight police between shops.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive them. Scan every new vehicle you pass, and the 100% checklist (200 of 277 base models) will carry you well past this trophy on its own.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to — so pick a gang fight, trigger Combat Focus when five or more gang members are in view, and drop them before the focus ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away. Get onto the tarmac, board a jet at a gate, take off and put distance between you and the airport — the trophy pops once you are roughly a kilometre out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest — get in, drive it out, and the trophy is yours. Expect heavy resistance on the way out, so plan your escape route before you climb in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you — so this only opens from Chapter 3 onward. Case the store, use the Snap Gun to stay quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4, and there are 8 vaults in total — the 100% checklist needs all 8, so rob every vault you find. Each job ends in a getaway, so have a fast car and an escape route ready before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or you can do it earlier: blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb, grab the cash and get away before the police close in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida and clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is fastest — fly a grid over the state and watch the fog lift. It pairs well with WAiNK scanning for You WAiNKer! and vehicle spotting for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this trophy comes early in that cleanup — work through the operations gang by gang and mark them off as you go.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact method is not yet confirmed by the guide writers — the working approach is to visit a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. Treat this one as unconfirmed and check the cited guides for updates.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is not yet confirmed by the guide writers — the working approach is to drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front and out the other side. Treat this one as unconfirmed and check the cited guides for updates.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later if you miss anything, so it is not missable — clear the operation and grab all three valuables before you leave.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress — gym sessions count for whoever is training, so train with your partner and keep at it until both bars are full.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. It comes naturally over a full playthrough — every robbery, stunt, race and crime nudges the profile, so just play and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store — the working idea is that it pops on a second attempt at something that failed the first time. Treat this one as unconfirmed and check the cited guides for updates.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline — the working idea is that it pops from a strange encounter or sighting somewhere in Leonida. Treat this one as unconfirmed and check the cited guides for updates.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle — ride past someone and land a melee hit from the bike.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences. It adds up across robberies — every marked bill you fence counts toward the total. The dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission, which makes laundering much easier, so push the story to Chapter 3 first.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest — buy the weapons and upgrades you actually want and the total climbs on its own. It counts across every shop, so there is no need to grind one store.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. PowerPyx puts the total at about $160,000, and the real estate app arrives in Chapter 2 — so this only opens from Chapter 2 onward. Buy them as you can afford them; garage space is also what On the Spot needs for registering vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes — buy a garage, park a vehicle in it, register it in the app, and repeat until you have ten.
trophies.name: On the Spot
